skill.name: ckm-design
skill.description: Create brand identity assets, logos, CIP mockups, slide decks, banners, social photos, SVG icons, and design-system guidance using bundled references and optional Gemini-powered scripts.
skill.summary: Design brand, marketing, presentation, and icon assets with guided workflows and optional Gemini generation.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown code fences, design vocabulary, placeholder setup text, and normal output-file generation. Confirmed risks are concentrated in broad .env loading, Gemini API-key handling, external Gemini data transfer, remote template assets, unescaped generated HTML, and a documented no-sandbox Chrome export workflow.

remediation.suggestion: Load only explicit GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY values, and require user opt-in before reading hidden ~/.claude .env files.
Add clear prompts or documentation before sending user prompts, logo images, or generated asset context to Google Gemini.
Escape brand names, industry labels, style labels, image alt text, and file-derived titles before writing HTML output.

remediation.issue: Headless Chrome runs with --no-sandbox in documentation
remediation.suggestion: Remove --no-sandbox from the recommended command unless a sandboxed environment requires it, and document the tradeoff.

remediation.issue: Remote CDN and font dependencies in templates
remediation.suggestion: Prefer pinned local assets or document that generated slides and social images may load remote scripts or fonts.

semantic_findings.title: External Gemini Data Transfer
semantic_findings.description: The logo, CIP, and icon generators send user prompts to Google Gemini, and the CIP generator can also send a user-provided logo image. This is expected for generation, but it is an external data transfer that should be explicit to users.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scripts directly call client.models.generate_content with prompt text, and CIP includes logo_image in contents when provided.

semantic_findings.title: Generated HTML Uses Unescaped User-Controlled Text
semantic_findings.description: The CIP HTML renderer inserts brand names, industry/style labels, and file-derived deliverable labels into HTML using f-strings. A malicious value could inject HTML or script into the local presentation output.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The renderer interpolates CLI-derived and filename-derived strings into HTML without visible escaping or sanitization in the reviewed file.

semantic_findings.title: Headless Browser Sandbox Disabled in Screenshot Workflow
semantic_findings.description: The social photo export reference recommends running Chrome with --no-sandbox while opening local HTML. This reduces browser isolation if generated HTML or remote assets are malicious.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented command includes --no-sandbox and opens a file URL for screenshot capture, which is a known hardening concern.

content.user_title: Create Brand and Marketing Design Assets
content.value_statement: Design teams often need consistent brand assets across many channels. This skill provides guided workflows, references, and optional generators for logos, CIP mockups, slides, banners, icons, and social images.
actual_capabilities: Routes logo, CIP, slide, banner, social photo, icon, brand, design-system, and UI styling tasks to specific guides.
Generates logo images through bundled Gemini scripts when the required API key and dependencies are present.
Creates corporate identity mockup prompts, generated mockup images, and HTML presentations from CIP assets.
Generates SVG icons, icon batches, and multi-size exports through the icon generator script.
Provides platform sizes, design rules, layout patterns, and Chart.js slide templates for marketing assets.
limitations: Gemini-based generation requires google-genai and a GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY configured by the user.
Some workflows depend on external skills or browser tools that are referenced but not bundled here.
Generated logos and images need human review for trademark, licensing, accessibility, and brand accuracy.
The scripts save local output files and may use user-provided output paths.

use_cases.title: Launch a Startup Brand Kit
use_cases.description: Create logo directions, color guidance, CIP mockups, and a presentation for a new company launch.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Build banners, social photos, and platform-specific image concepts for a marketing campaign.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Presentation Visuals
use_cases.description: Use slide templates, chart guidance, and visual hierarchy rules to create a polished deck.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Logo Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple brand identity task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three logo directions for a modern wellness brand named Solara. Include style, colors, typography, and usage notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Social Campaign Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for multi-platform marketing images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design social image concepts for a product launch on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Use a clean technology style and provide exact sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a CIP Mockup Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a corporate identity program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a corporate identity program for a consulting brand. Include business cards, letterhead, signage, apparel, vehicle, and presentation mockups.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Full Brand Presentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request combining multiple built-in workflows.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete brand presentation for a fintech startup. Include logo rationale, color system, CIP applications, slide outline, banner concepts, and icon style rules.

output_examples.input: Create a logo direction for a premium coffee subscription named Ember Roast.
output_examples.output: A concise logo brief with style options, color palette recommendations, typography direction, symbol concepts, and generation guidance.

output_examples.input: Make LinkedIn and Instagram launch visuals for a new analytics feature.
output_examples.output: Platform-specific art directions with recommended dimensions, safe-zone guidance, copy hierarchy, and export notes.

output_examples.input: Prepare a CIP presentation for a legal consulting firm.
output_examples.output: A structured set of identity applications, mockup recommendations, presentation sections, and review criteria for brand consistency.

best_practices: Confirm brand name, audience, channels, and required formats before generating visual assets.
Keep generated outputs in a dedicated project folder so source images, mockups, and exports stay organized.
Review every generated asset for accessibility, trademark risk, brand consistency, and platform size requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not treat AI-generated logos as legally cleared trademarks without separate review.
Do not provide sensitive client assets to external generation APIs without permission.
Do not rely on one generated option when the workflow expects comparison, iteration, and user feedback.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images automatically?
faq.answer: It can use bundled Gemini scripts for logos, CIP mockups, and icons when the user configures the required API key and dependencies.

faq.question: Can it create social media images for different platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes platform sizes and workflow guidance for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Pinterest, TikTok, and related formats.

faq.question: Does it include design system work?
faq.answer: It routes design-system and UI styling tasks to referenced external skills, while built-in guides cover visual assets and presentation workflows.

faq.question: What dependencies are needed for generation scripts?
faq.answer: The Gemini scripts require Python packages such as google-genai, and some CIP image workflows also require pillow.

faq.question: Are generated assets ready for production use?
faq.answer: They should be reviewed for brand fit, accessibility, trademark risk, licensing, and platform requirements before publication.

faq.question: Does the skill send data to external services?
faq.answer: Yes, Gemini generation scripts send prompts and sometimes images to Google Gemini when those scripts are run.
